declarations.name: BlockDotProduct.block_dot_product_sequential
declarations.type:
∀ (n T : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 n →
    LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
      ∀ (u : Real),
        LE.le.{0} 0 u →
          ∀ (x y : Fin n → Real) (trace : BlockDotProduct.RoundingTrace u),
            LT.lt.{0}
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                  (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (BlockDotProduct.treeDepth (BlockDotProduct.blockCount n T)))) u)
                1 →
              LT.lt.{0}
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                    (↑(HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (BlockDotProduct.blockCount n T)) 1)) u)
                  1 →
                ∃ Δx Δy,
                  And
                    (Eq.{1} (BlockDotProduct.sequentialBlockDotProduct x y T trace)
                      (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (Δx i)) (y i)))
                    (And
                      (∀ (i : Fin n),
                        LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δx i))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                            (BlockDotProduct.gamma
                              (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (BlockDotProduct.blockCount n T)) 1) u)
                            (abs.{0} (x i))))
                      (And
                        (Eq.{1} (BlockDotProduct.sequentialBlockDotProduct x y T trace)
                          (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (y i) (Δy i))))
                        (∀ (i : Fin n),
                          LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δy i))
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                              (BlockDotProduct.gamma
                                (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (BlockDotProduct.blockCount n T)) 1) u)
                              (abs.{0} (y i))))))

fun entry error x =>
  Nat.brecOn.{1} x fun x f =>
    (match (motive := (x : Nat) → Nat.below.{1} x → Real) x with
      | 0 => fun x => 0
      | Nat.succ k => fun x =>
        ite.{1} (Eq.{1} k 0) (entry 0)
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} x.1 (entry k)) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 (error k))))
      f
